```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringi)

source("../../R/theme_reltur.R")
source("../../R/join_dest_type.R")

for (d in c("output/tables", "output/figures")) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# 0. Configuration

```{r}
#| label: config

config_2g <- list(
  input_corpus = "data/destinations_analytical_final.rds",
  seed = 2026L
)
set.seed(config_2g$seed)
```

# 1. Load Corpus

```{r}
#| label: load

long <- readRDS(config_2g$input_corpus)
setDT(long)

if (!"dest_type_cat" %in% names(long)) long <- join_dest_type(long)
if (!"year_num" %in% names(long)) {
  long[, year_num := as.integer(format(date, "%Y")) - 2021L]
}
long[, year := as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))]

cat("Corpus rows:", format(nrow(long), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Years covered:", paste(sort(unique(long$year)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Destinations:", paste(sort(unique(long$destination)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

# 2. Annual Frame Shares per Destination

```{r}
#| label: annual-frames

annual_frames <- long[, .N, by = .(destination, year, dominant_frame)]
annual_frames[, total := sum(N), by = .(destination, year)]
annual_frames[, pct := round(N / total * 100, 1)]

fwrite(annual_frames, "output/tables/02g_annual_frames.csv")
```

# 3. Tourism-Share Trend Regression

```{r}
#| label: tourism-trend

tourism_annual <- long[, .(
  tourism_share = mean(dominant_frame %in%
                       c("tourism_only", "religious_tourism_mixed"))
), by = .(destination, year_num, dest_type_cat)]

fwrite(tourism_annual, "output/tables/02g_tourism_annual.csv")

trend_model <- lm(tourism_share ~ year_num + dest_type_cat + destination,
                  data = tourism_annual)
cat("Tourism share trend regression:\n")
print(summary(trend_model))
```

# 4. COVID vs Post-COVID Comparison

```{r}
#| label: covid-comparison

long[, period := fifelse(year == 2021L, "covid_2021", "post_covid")]

period_frames <- long[, .N, by = .(destination, period, dominant_frame)]
period_frames[, total := sum(N), by = .(destination, period)]
period_frames[, pct := round(N / total * 100, 1)]

period_wide <- dcast(
  period_frames[dominant_frame == "religious_only"],
  destination ~ period,
  value.var = "pct",
  fill = 0
)
setnames(period_wide,
         c("covid_2021", "post_covid"),
         c("religious_only_pct_2021", "religious_only_pct_post"),
         skip_absent = TRUE)

fwrite(period_wide, "output/tables/02g_covid_frame_comparison.csv")
print(period_wide)
```

# 5. Plot: Tourism Share by Year

```{r}
#| label: tourism-trend-plot

p_trend <- ggplot(
  tourism_annual,
  aes(x = year_num + 2021L, y = tourism_share * 100,
      colour = destination, group = destination)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ dest_type_cat, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2021:2024) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Tourism frame share (%)",
       title = "Godišnje kretanje turističkog okvira po destinaciji",
       colour = "Destinacija") +
  theme_reltur() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave("output/figures/02g_tourism_trend.png", p_trend,
       width = 18, height = 14, dpi = 300)
p_trend
```

# 6. Decision Gate

```{r}
#| label: decision-gate

cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("DECISION GATE 2g\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

checks <- list(
  corpus_loaded       = nrow(long) > 0,
  dest_type_present   = "dest_type_cat" %in% names(long),
  annual_frames_saved = file.exists("output/tables/02g_annual_frames.csv"),
  tourism_plot_saved  = file.exists("output/figures/02g_tourism_trend.png"),
  trend_model_ok      = !is.null(trend_model)
)

for (nm in names(checks)) {
  cat(nm, ":", ifelse(checks[[nm]], "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
}
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
```
